field_checks.summary: All 130 activity rows were enumerated and their raw source cells matched the workbook, but 9 Supplementary Data 10 S. aureus log10 MIC rows are assigned to ATCC 25923 even though the values match the Fig. 4/Data 3 ATCC 29213 series; the conflict is not preserved in the final activity artifact.

The four database candidate records remain unresolved and fallback rows are not promoted, but the current database final still contains recursive citation source_locator_paths to packet/database manifests plus stale blocker/open-ticket fields after adjudication.

Core paper/packet finals are byte-identical, but paper final materials_manifest.json is stale: it reports analysis_queue_status=analysis_queued and locator_count=205, while the live packet reports analysis_source_reviewed_accepted and locator_count=16655; it is also not mirrored under packet final.

The direct PI mechanism boundary is mostly preserved, but mechanism claim PMC12125351-MECH-004 uses xml:p:27 as its primary source_locator for MIC/antimicrobial phenotype even though p27 is a conformation/similarity paragraph; the supporting phenotype evidence is elsewhere.

Paper identity is source-verified from XML/PDF and p15/p17/p20 source sequences and sequence_length fields match independently counted residues; however no authoritative DBAASP linked rows are present, so database entity linkage remains unresolved candidate provenance only.

All 2116 source-like locator fields resolved and 472 activity/toxicity source cell comparisons matched exactly, but provenance integrity fails because target/strain conflict and hemolysis assay-condition fields are scientifically wrong or unpreserved.

Fallback release boundary is preserved: authoritative DBAASP ingest is false and fallback rows are not source_verified. Recursive authority is not clean because database citation_traceability/source_locator_paths point to packet/database manifests instead of primary XML article-id locators.

The P. aeruginosa prose-vs-table conflict and no-authoritative-DB caution are preserved, but the Supplementary Data 10 S. aureus strain/value conflict is not, and green strict gates did not detect it.

All four staged supplements were readable and independently inspected; the workbook has 12 parsed sheets with row/cell locators. MOESM1 page 4 is absent from packet supplementary_text and locator_index but is present in worker-3 recovery/thumbnail evidence, so the surface is reviewed but packet/final metadata still needs cleanup.

Toxicity/selectivity value coverage is complete by source cell count, but 63 HC50/percent hemolysis records carry incubation_time=24 h even though the hemolysis method states 1 h; CC50/cell-viability 24 h records are not affected.

cautions.summary: Authoritative DBAASP article/assay/sequence/literature snapshots are empty for this paper; fallback machine rows remain unresolved and authoritative_dbaasp_ingest_ready is false, so release boundary is preserved but database linkage is not source-verified.
